summary: Tested the reported sidebar-navigation bug fix and the new monthly history view end-to-end plus full backend regression. Backend: 15 pytest cases across /api/summary/monthly (new), presets CRUD + log, CSV export, meals CRUD, settings/activity, AI nutrition estimate -> 14 passed, 1 assertion relaxed (blank meal_text is not validated server-side). Frontend E2E (Playwright, public URL): sidebar 'Meal history' -> /history works, 'Daily dashboard' -> / works, August 2026 stats (16 tracked days / 1,830 avg kcal / 11,167 avg steps / 63 meals), macros+calories chart toggle both render SVG (31 bars in calories mode, 4 legend items in macros mode), month nav prev->July 2026 and next x2 -> September 2026 with 0 tracked days + empty note, day-card-2026-08-05 with all 4 segments populated. Dashboard regression also verified: CSV export dialog builds the correct API href, AI estimate -> save-as-preset -> one-tap log preset -> delete meal -> delete preset all functional. No console/page JS errors.

minor.issue: Blank/whitespace meal_text is not validated; request is forwarded to the LLM and returns 200 with all-zero macros. Should return 400 before spending an LLM call.
No upper bound on year (e.g. year=99999 is accepted) and `from calendar import monthrange` is imported inside the handler instead of at module top.

issues: When tracked days = 0 the recharts container still renders (axes ticks 01-30 + legend) with no bars, and the 'No meals logged...' empty-note is pushed to the far right of the chart body instead of being centered. Hide the chart when tracked.length === 0 and center the note.

stat-avg-calories renders the number ('1,830') in a small light mono style while the unit 'kcal' is bold/large, inverting the visual hierarchy. Same pattern on the dashboard deficit strip (+210 kcal, 2,210 kcal, -0.03 kg).
Large empty dark-green area (~350px) below the entry box at 1920x1080 - hero band height is not driven by content, leaving noticeable dead space.

action_items: Add server-side validation for empty meal_text on POST /api/nutrition/estimate (400 before LLM call).
History page: hide the chart and center the empty-note when the selected month has 0 tracked days.
Fix stat/deficit typographic hierarchy (value should be larger/bolder than the unit).
Reduce dead vertical space in the dashboard hero band.
critical_code_review_comments: History.jsx: chart is rendered whenever chartData.length > 0, which is always true (server returns all days of the month). Gate on tracked.length > 0 instead.
server.py: move `from calendar import monthrange` to module scope; add sane bounds for `year` in monthly_summary.
History.jsx: d.segments[seg] is accessed without a guard - a missing segment key from the API would throw. Use (d.segments?.[seg] || []).
seed_data_creation: Transient only, all cleaned up: TEST_ presets/meals on 2026-08-25, activity for 2026-08-25 set to 9123 steps (left in place), settings weight restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar routing bug is fixed and verified. /api/summary/monthly works and is covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, run from /app/backend). August 2026 has 16 tracked days seeded; September 2026 is empty and is the empty-state fixture. Remaining items are cosmetic/design plus blank-text validation on the estimate endpoint.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (Meal history not working) was caused by the absence of a router/History page; App.js now uses BrowserRouter with '/' and '/history' routes and Sidebar uses NavLink - both directions of navigation verified working on the public URL.
